verdict.rationale: Wave offers scheduled/rule-based automations (recurring invoices, auto payment reminders, auto bank transaction import/categorization, automatic payroll tax filing) but these are fixed workflow automations, not AI-native, goal-directed, or autonomous agent-style automations that a user can configure with custom logic or triggers. There is no evidence of an API, webhook, or agent framework enabling background autonomous tasks beyond these built-in scheduled features. missing for 10: evidence of user-configurable autonomous automation logic, API/webhook access for building custom automations, AI-driven decision-making in automations, and any agentic orchestration capability.
